name: rebootgs
description:
reboot(2) COLD-STARTS THE MACHINE.  /sbin/reboot syncs, signals, and calls reboot(2); the kernel banks the Monitor ROM in and enters PWRUP ($00FAA6) in emulation mode, which re-runs the IIgs cold start and boots FGX again.

WHAT DISCRIMINATES IT: `/sbin/reboot' is the command the harness TYPED, so it is echoed on the screen of any run that did not restart.  A run that did restart cleared the screen and rendered a fresh boot over it, so the echo is gone and the banner on screen is the SECOND boot's.  `NEVER' is the shell command after the reboot: reaching it means reboot(2) returned, which it must not.

Measured while building this: with the language card still selected for RAM -- FGX's own IRQ direct page lives at bank 0 $FA00 -- $00FAA6 was interrupt scratch rather than PWRUP, and the machine wedged with the screen holding FGX's last frame.  That reads exactly like `the reboot did nothing', which is why this asserts on the ECHO being gone rather than on the banner being present.
